metadata.title: Meta infrastructure chief to hand over AI compute role in 2027

content.text:
Meta Platforms' longtime infrastructure chief Santosh Janardhan will leave after the end of 1Q27, with former Amazon Web Services (AWS) vice president Dave Brown set to succeed him...
